findings.summary: 'The object namespace holds no retained class' is false: a relative oo::class create in a member body lives in ::oo::ObjN and wins for nextto (p7); the analyser retains it keyed ::Name with source_name None (scope.rs:166, handlers.rs:10721-10734). Reword as an explicit limitation; 'same-tail' -> 'name reached under a path namespace'.
Class-object frames (self method, mixins on a class object, metaclass instance methods) have path '::oo::Helpers ::oo' (p5,p6); same-tail ::oo class wins in tclsh, candidate answers root.

Only classes are probed on the path; a proc in ::oo::Helpers, builtin helpers (self/next/link/...) or per-object my shadow a root class -> tclsh 'does not refer to an object' (p1 G, p2), candidate answers root.
Shadow probe treats a None from collision/ambiguity withdrawal as absence (absence-as-completeness).
Runtime 'namespace path' edits in constructors (common idiom) change nextto resolution (p8); recorded namespace_path_computed is ignored.
nextto inside namespace eval within a method raises in tclsh (p4) but path stays non-empty, so candidate answers.
Use tcl_syntax::naming::qualify(namespace, name) (naming.rs:1445) instead of format!; keep the starts_with("::") guard.
